authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The full morning expression is day + rise, with local fusion and ordinary finite/past endings. Turner dina gives the regional din/day stem and *udgāti explicitly includes Old Marwari ūgai rises and the sun-rising sense. No independent go auxiliary is assumed just from the gy sequence inside the past of ug-.
